**`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Owner.java`** — `@Entity @Table(name="owners")`, extends `Person`. Its own fields:
- `address` — `@NotEmpty`
- `city` — `@NotEmpty`
- `telephone` — `@NotEmpty @Digits(fraction=0, integer=10) @Pattern(regexp="^[0-9]{10}$", message="Phone number must be exactly 10 digits")`
- `pets` — `@OneToMany`

`firstName` / `lastName` live on the parent **`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Person.java`** (`@MappedSuperclass`), both `@NotEmpty`. `Person` extends **`BaseEntity`** (`.../model/BaseEntity.java`) which supplies the `@Id @GeneratedValue` `id` and `isNew()`.

Note: these Bean Validation annotations are on the JPA entity, but the REST create path does NOT validate the entity — it validates the generated DTO (see below).

### 2. REST controller — POST create owner

**`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/controller/v1/OwnerRestControllerV1.java`**, method `addOwner(OwnerFieldsDto ownerFieldsDto)` (lines 99-109). It implements the OpenAPI-generated `OwnersApi` interface; the actual `POST /api/owners` mapping and `@Valid` on the body come from that generated interface. It maps the DTO to an `Owner` via `OwnerMapper`, calls `clinicService.saveOwner`, and returns `201 CREATED` with a `Location` header.

The V2 controller (`.../rest/controller/v2/OwnerRestControllerV2.java`) only has a paged list endpoint — no create.

The request DTO `OwnerFieldsDto` and the `OwnersApi` interface are **OpenAPI-generated at build time** (not in the source tree). Their validation constraints come from **`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/openapi.yml`** (schema `OwnerFields`, lines 1991-2039): all of firstName, lastName, address, city, telephone are `required`, with `minLength: 1`, maxLengths, and patterns (firstName/lastName letter patterns; telephone `^[0-9]*$`). The mapper is **`.../mapper/OwnerMapper.java`** (MapStruct, `toOwner(OwnerFieldsDto)` ignores id/pets).

### 3. Validation / error handling → 400 JSON

**`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/advice/ExceptionControllerAdvice.java`** — `@ControllerAdvice`. `handleMethodArgumentNotValidException` (lines 132-163) handles `MethodArgumentNotValidException` and returns `400`. components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1

## Summary

The spec requires rejecting owner creation when any of `firstName`, `lastName`, `address`, `city`, or `telephone` is **missing or blank**, returning **400** with a JSON body whose `errors` array lists each offending field name.

I found the existing validation pipeline already covered most of this via the OpenAPI-generated DTO (`@NotNull @Size(min=1)` + patterns) feeding `MethodArgumentNotValidException` → `ExceptionControllerAdvice`. Two gaps remained, which I closed by keeping each concern where it belongs:

1. **Blank (whitespace-only) `address`/`city` slipped through** — `@Size(min=1)` counts whitespace, and those two fields had no pattern (unlike `firstName`/`lastName`/`telephone`, whose patterns already reject whitespace). I added a non-blank constraint `pattern: '.*\S.*'` to `address` and `city` in `src/main/resources/openapi.yml`, alongside the other field constraints. Now the *same* `@Valid` pipeline uniformly rejects missing **and** blank values for all five fields — no duplicated validation logic.

2. **The 400 body exposed `schemaValidationErrors`, not `errors`** — In `ExceptionControllerAdvice.handleMethodArgumentNotValidException`, I added a top-level `errors` property built from the binding field errors (distinct field names). This is a small, generic addition to the code that already inspects those errors, so every validation-400 now advertises the offending field names.

Net changes: two one-line constraint additions in the API contract, and one small change in the global exception advice — no new classes, no copied logic, and the whole rule flows through the single existing validation path.
